import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']

def load(s):
 d=get_index_daily_data(s,days=3000)
 if d is None:return None
 d=d.copy(); d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d.date); d=d.set_index('date'); return d[['close','pct_change']].astype(float)
D={s:load(s) for s in U}; D={s:d for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}
# volatility compression: negative recent vol relative to long vol; exact lagged factor, forward daily returns
rets=pd.DataFrame({s:d['close'].pct_change() for s,d in D.items()})
# use 20d realized vol vs 60d, factor positive when compressed (long lower vol)
vol=rets.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()/rets.rolling(60,min_periods=45).std()
f=-vol.shift(1)
ics={h:[] for h in [1,5,10]}; dates={h:[] for h in [1,5,10]}; ranks=[]
for dt in f.index:
 for h in ics:
  y=rets.shift(-h).loc[dt]
  x=f.loc[dt]; z=pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   ics[h].append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); dates[h].append(dt)
 if dt in f.index and f.loc[dt].notna().sum()>=8:ranks.append(f.loc[dt].rank(pct=True))
print('assets',len(D),'range',rets.index.min(),rets.index.max())
for h in ics:
 a=np.array(ics[h]); print(h,'dates',len(a),'IC',np.nanmean(a),'ICIR',np.nanmean(a)/np.nanstd(a,ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(a>0))
print('coverage',f.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(D),'turnover',pd.DataFrame(ranks).diff().abs().mean().mean())
# regime means daily
for yr in sorted(set(x.year for x in dates[1])):
 a=np.array([v for v,d in zip(ics[1],dates[1]) if d.year==yr]); print(yr,len(a),round(np.nanmean(a),5),round(np.nanmean(a)/np.nanstd(a,ddof=1),4))
# correlation to persisted signals unavailable; print pooled factor correlations among candidates
print('factor avg corr with 5d return', f.corrwith(rets.rolling(5).sum()).mean())

ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np, pandas as pd\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data\\nU=[\'000300.SH\',\'SPX\',\'HSI\',\'N225\',\'SX5E\',\'000688.SH\',\'SOX\',\'NDX\',\'XAU\',\'COPPER\',\'WTI\',\'BTC\',\'ETH\',\'US10Y\',\'CN10Y\']\\nR={}; F={}\\nfor s in U:\\n d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000)\\n if d is None: continue\\n d=d.sort_values(\'date\').set_index(\'date\'); r=d.close.astype(float).pct_change()\\n R[s]=r; F[s]=-(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()/r.rolling(60,min_periods=45).std()).shift(1)\\nrets=pd.DataFrame(R); f=pd.DataFrame(F); print(\'assets\',len(R),\'dates\',len(rets),\'range\',rets.index.min(),rets.index.max())\\nics={h:[] for h in [1,5,10]}; dates={h:[] for h in [1,5,10]}; ranks=[]\\nfor dt in f.index:\\n for h in ics:\\n  y=rets.shift(-h).loc[dt]; z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()\\n  if len(z)>=8: ics[h].append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method=\'spearman\')); dates[h].append(dt)\\n if f.loc[dt].notna().sum()>=8:ranks.append(f.loc[dt].rank(pct=True))\\nfor h in ics:\\n a=np.array(ics[h]); print(h,\'dates\',len(a),\'avgN\',np.mean([len(pd.concat([f.loc[d],rets.shift(-h).loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()) for d in dates[h]]),\'IC\',np.nanmean(a),\'ICIR\',np.nanmean(a)/np.nanstd(a,ddof=1),\'hit\',np.mean(a>0))\\nprint(\'coverage\',f.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(R),\'turnover\',pd.DataFrame(ranks).diff().abs().mean().mean())\\nfor yr in sorted(set(x.year for x in dates[1])):\\n a=np.array([v for v,d in zip(ics[1],dates[1]) if d.year==yr]); print(yr,len(a),round(np.nanmean(a),5),round(np.nanmean(a)/np.nanstd(a,ddof=1),4))\\nprint(\'independent proxy corr with 5d return\',f.corrwith(rets.rolling(5).sum()).mean())\\n","file_path":"scripts/miner_2_20260730_vol_compression.py"}', call_id='call_1OpCAvuWLPz6afSATG8w785Y', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_092d2cf2cdb393d1016a7869e6e4fc819a9fd47c0a95931c78', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')
